تنتحلين (form VIII)
# تَنْتَحِلِينَ (tantaḥilīna) /tan.ta.ħi.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
# تُنْتَحَلِينَ (tuntaḥalīna) /tun.ta.ħa.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
